This is a static calculator.
It does not take user inputs, but it does use changing prices from the Grand Exchange Market Watch. If prices appear to be outdated, purge the page by clicking here.
RuneScape:Grand Exchange Market Watch/Alchemy

Grand Exchange items profitable with the High Level Alchemy (and Low Level Alchemy) spell.

High Level Alchemy profit

[edit source]
  • The profit is based on the Grand Exchange price for a Nature rune, currently 147 coins (update). If this looks incorrect, click this link to force a new cache of this page.
  • ROI (return on investment) is calculated by dividing profit with the price of the item and the price of a Nature rune.
  • Volume refers to the daily volume of a given item.
  • Maximum profit is calculated by multiplying profit with the buying limit, capped at 4,800 (1,200 casts of High Level Alchemy an hour for 4 hours). However, if the volume is less than 6 times the buying limit and also below 28,800, the maximum profit is calculated by profit * (volume / 6).
  • Profit per minute is the rate of profit over time, but the buying limit might mean you cannot actually profit that much per minute.
  • Keep in mind that your profit per minute will be severely reduced if your valuable drop warning system is set too low when alchemising high-value items.

Low Level Alchemy profit

[edit source]

This table shows the exact same list of items, but shows the profit (or more commonly, loss) when casting Low Level Alchemy.

  • The profit is based on the Grand Exchange price for a Nature rune, currently 147 coins (update).
  • ROI (return on investment) is calculated by dividing profit with the price of the item and the price of a Nature rune.
  • Maximum profit is calculated by multiplying profit with the buying limit, capped at 4,800 (1,200 casts of Low Level Alchemy for 4 hours).
  • Profit per minute is the rate of profit over time, but the buying limit might mean you cannot actually profit that much per minute.
